item.title: Vampires. Part 3 by Desislava Ignatova / PPT blog
item.description: Here we are, at the foot front of the final quartet. You are about to meet the last 4 vampires of this series. They have the potential to be so elegant in their ways to use you and drain you, that you might never even realize it.

item.title: Anatomy of trust by Desislava Ignatova / PPT blog
item.description: Have you ever wondered why trust is so fragile and once broken, it’s nearly impossible to be built up again? What exactly does it mean to trust someone? Do you equally trust yourself and others? Moreover, which one do you find easier to trust?

item.title: With Help from Akutagawa and Peseschkian - by Mamuka Badridze | PPT Blog
item.description: Presumably, all psychologists or psychotherapists can name the most special and unforgettable moments they have experienced at work. I would like to share one of such experiences – an episode from my session with a former client who kindly permitted me to tell about it.

item.title: Submissive love is a bondage love
item.description: "I'm worried about my son right now; he used to always be close to me, but now he's hiding from me and his academic performance has plummeted. Being eight months pregnant and having limited mobility has burnt my relationship with my child."

item.title: Psychology and Faith. Part 1
item.description: Blog post by Igor Olenichenko. Available in English and Russian. Every conscious person believes in something. Some believe in God or analogous concepts like a Higher Being or the Force of the Universe. Some believe in themselves, while others believe in a "bright future." Most of these individuals are associated with some religious or philosophical direction. Undoubtedly, this belief helps each person live, supports them, and motivates them to achieve.B

item.title: Psychology and Faith. Part 2
item.description: Discover the second part of fascinating intersections between psychology and faith in the latest post of PPT Blog. By Igor Olenichenko from Odesa (Ukraine).

item.title: Жизнь в ожидании Мира
item.description: Есть только сегодняшний день, настоящая минута жизни. Просто прекрасно иметь планы, мечтать о будущем и двигать в направлении этих планов, но при этом жизнь не в будущем, не дома, не в мирное время, она здесь и сейчас. Дети растут невероятно быстро тоже здесь и сейчас.
